answer: Fake identities multiply, but each must post the same bond and sustain genuine co-signing to earn attestations. One concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is a staked-identity reef: each agent locks a bond to register, and every epoch a randomized pulse samples peers to co-sign activity. An attacker flooding thousands of sybils faces proportional capital lockup plus slashing risk on every sampled pulse, while honest agents recover stakes in good standing. This turns identity into a costly oasis of verified reputation, making mass forgery economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0205...
